# n8n

> > n8n is a workflow automation platform that connects apps like Google Sheets, Slack, OpenAI, Airtable, and 400+ other services through visual workflows and API integrations.

n8n enables technical and non-technical users to build powerful automation workflows with a node-based interface. It supports self-hosting, offers extensive integrations with popular tools like GitHub, Telegram, Gmail, and databases like Postgres and MongoDB, and provides both open-source and enterprise solutions.
